title: [Master]-Missing VAT Identifier in Peppol XML for Zero-Value Invoice
summary: PEPPOL XML export now includes the VAT identifier for zero-value invoices, where it was previously missing. The fix is in the PEPPOL30 Impl. codeunit, and BIS billing tests were added.
key_points: The VAT identifier is no longer missing from PEPPOL XML for zero-value invoices
The fix is in codeunit 37201 PEPPOL30 Impl.
Tests were added to the PEPPOL BIS billing test codeunit
